title: Seasons and Weather (KS1)
subject: Science
strapline: The four seasons and how the weather changes.
facts: There are four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
In spring, days get longer and warmer, plants grow and baby animals are born.
In summer, the days are longest and warmest.
In autumn, leaves change colour and fall, and the days get shorter.
In winter, the days are shortest and coldest, and some animals hibernate.
Weather is what it is like outside now: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, snowy or foggy.
In the UK it is usually lightest and warmest in summer and darkest and coldest in winter.

quick_quiz.q: In which season do leaves fall from the trees?
Which season has the shortest, coldest days?

teacher_tips: Keep a daily weather chart so patterns build up over the term.
Photograph the same tree each season to show change over time.
